new_candidates.body:
## Bug description

`examples/rigid/grasp_bottle.py` grasps and lifts the bottle, but the bottle slips out of the fingers about 70-120 steps into the lift phase and falls back to the floor. In the full example (49 envs) the bottle is lost in 49 of 49 envs. During the slip the finger dofs keep closing under the `-20 N` force command and settle at `-0.0064`, below their lower limit of `0.0`.

It is the same on `gs.cpu` and `gs.gpu` and on genesis-world 1.4.4 and 1.4.5, so it does not look backend-specific.

## Steps to reproduce

The example reduced to one env on `gs.cpu` (same scene, gains, IK targets and step counts; `plan_path` replaced by a direct position target, since the slip happens later, in the lift):

```python
"""examples/rigid/grasp_bottle.py (Genesis 1.4.5) reduced to one env on gs.cpu, printing the bottle height.
Same scene, gains, IK targets and step counts as the example; plan_path is replaced by a direct position target
(the slip happens after planning, in the lift phase)."""
import sys
import numpy as np
import genesis as gs

backend = gs.gpu if "--gpu" in sys.argv else gs.cpu
gs.init(backend=backend, logging_level="warning", seed=0)
scene = gs.Scene(sim_options=gs.options.SimOptions(dt=0.01), show_viewer=False)
scene.add_entity(gs.morphs.URDF(file="urdf/plane/plane.urdf", fixed=True))
bottle = scene.add_entity(
    material=gs.materials.Rigid(rho=300),
    morph=gs.morphs.URDF(file="urdf/3763/mobility_vhacd.urdf", scale=0.09, pos=(0.65, 0.0, 0.036), euler=(0, 90, 0)),
)
franka = scene.add_entity(gs.morphs.MJCF(file="xml/franka_emika_panda/panda.xml"))
scene.build()
motors_dof, fingers_dof = np.arange(7), np.arange(7, 9)
franka.set_qpos(np.array([1.56, -0.72, -0.02, -2.09, 0.04, 1.33, 2.4, 0.01, 0.01]))
franka.set_dofs_kp(np.array([4500, 4500, 3500, 3500, 2000, 2000, 2000, 100, 100]))
franka.set_dofs_kv(np.array([450, 450, 350, 350, 200, 200, 200, 10, 10]))
franka.set_dofs_force_range(np.array([-87, -87, -87, -87, -12, -12, -12, -100, -100]),
                            np.array([87, 87, 87, 87, 12, 12, 12, 100, 100]))
hand = franka.get_link("hand")
step = 0


def run(n, phase):
    global step
    for _ in range(n):
        scene.step()
        step += 1
        if step % 50 == 0:
            f = franka.get_dofs_position(fingers_dof)
            print(f"step {step:4d} {phase:6s} bottle z {float(bottle.get_pos()[2]):.3f}  hand z {float(hand.get_pos()[2]):.3f}"
                  f"  fingers {float(f[0]):.4f} {float(f[1]):.4f}")


q = franka.inverse_kinematics(link=hand, pos=np.array([0.65, 0.0, 0.25]), quat=np.array([0, 1, 0, 0]))
q[-2:] = 0.04
franka.control_dofs_position(q)
run(230, "pre")       # the example follows a 200-waypoint plan_path, then 30 steps
q = franka.inverse_kinematics(link=hand, pos=np.array([0.65, 0.0, 0.142]), quat=np.array([0, 1, 0, 0]))
franka.control_dofs_position(q[:-2], motors_dof)
run(100, "reach")
franka.control_dofs_position(np.array([0, 0]), fingers_dof)
run(100, "grasp")
q = franka.inverse_kinematics(link=hand, pos=np.array([0.65, 0.0, 0.3]), quat=np.array([0, 1, 0, 0]))
franka.control_dofs_position(q[:-2], motors_dof)
franka.control_dofs_force(np.array([-20, -20]), fingers_dof)
run(1000, "lift")
print("final bottle z", float(bottle.get_pos()[2]), "(start 0.036; lifted would be ~0.19)")
```

Output (genesis-world 1.4.5, gs.cpu, trimmed):

```
step  400 grasp  bottle z 0.034  hand z 0.134  fingers 0.0170 0.0170
step  450 lift   bottle z 0.132  hand z 0.233  fingers 0.0147 0.0147
step  480 lift   bottle z 0.187  hand z 0.290  fingers 0.0133 0.0133
step  500 lift   bottle z 0.185  hand z 0.293  fingers 0.0124 0.0124
step  520 lift   bottle z 0.178  hand z 0.293  fingers 0.0100 0.0100
step  530 lift   bottle z 0.169  hand z 0.293  fingers 0.0065 0.0065
step  535 lift   bottle z 0.098  hand z 0.293  fingers -0.0065 -0.0065
step  540 lift   bottle z 0.036  hand z 0.293  fingers -0.0064 -0.0064
...
step 1400 lift   bottle z 0.034  hand z 0.293  fingers -0.0064 -0.0064
final bottle z 0.034...
```

`franka.get_dofs_limit(fingers_dof)` gives `(0, 0)` to `(0.04, 0.04)`.

Replacing the lift-phase force command with position control (`control_dofs_position([0, 0], fingers_dof)`) gives the same result a few steps later (bottle z 0.127 at step 550, final z 0.020).

The unmodified example shows the same thing on `gs.gpu` with 49 envs: every env lifts the bottle to z ~0.185 m by step 600 (the lift starts at step 530, after the 300 plan waypoints, 30 settle, 100 reach and 100 grasp steps), then drops it between steps 600 and 650; the final bottle height is below its start height in all 49 envs (median -0.016 m). A `gs.cpu` run of the same script gives a very similar trajectory (median -0.018 m).

## Expected behavior

The bottle stays in the gripper at about z 0.19 m until the end of the lift, as the example intends.

## Actual behavior

The bottle slips out about 100 steps into the lift; the finger joints close past the bottle and below their lower joint limit.

## Environment

- genesis-world 1.4.5 (also 1.4.4), quadrants 1.3.3, Python 3.12
- `gs.cpu`: torch 2.15.0+cpu, Linux x86_64
- `gs.gpu` (49 envs): AMD Instinct MI355X, ROCm 7.x (torch 2.15.0+rocm10.0)
